title: Chapter 1: It Seems the Duchess is Coming to Marry 3
content: The upper echelons are orchestrating things this way to ensure that no other forces are directed elsewhere.
That’s why the Royal Capital is peaceful.
I have no concrete proof, but I suspect there are secret agreements made between nations.
In exchange, they provide us with decent, albeit not luxurious, food and weapons.
Haha, people die just to let off steam, huh?
What a ridiculous story.
It feels like they’re being sacrificed just to move the pieces on the chessboard of the game’s order.
“The only entertainment here is betting on who will die next, and that’s quite popular.”
“Y-yeah…”
“A month ago, there was someone who made a profit betting that my father would die in battle.”
When I casually mentioned it, Alicia’s expression turned sour, but it couldn’t be helped; it was the truth.
Maybe I misjudged how to bring up the topic?
“This isn’t really a conversation for women, my apologies.”
“N-no, it’s fine. If that’s the norm here…”
I could feel her forcing herself to accept it, trying hard to adapt to this place, so I decided to say something.
“I think it’s questionable to adapt too much to what’s considered normal here.”
“Wha! You’re saying that after trying to accept me!”
“It’s not that easy to accept something just because you want to, haha.”
I smiled at Alicia, who was fuming, with a Sebas smile.
“What’s wrong with you…?”
We had been talking somewhat casually along the way.

There was no way I could ask her what had happened at the academy, so I just mentioned how everything burned down about ten years ago, or how the black stains on the stone walls were from a dragon’s breath that scorched even the shadows, sharing information about the town without touching on sensitive topics.
Alicia listened quietly to my stories, occasionally shifting her gaze from the carriage window, showing that she wasn’t completely uninterested.
She seemed quite perplexed, but for a first attempt, I felt like I was doing well and silently pumped my fist in triumph.
“Haah…”
Since the conversation was flowing nicely, I wiped the sweat from my forehead and spoke to Alicia, who was leaning against a tree, letting out a sigh.
“I haven’t accepted it either, and if I did, I’d be dead.”
There are countless monsters here, and it’s only natural that everyone would be killed if the neighboring country attacked; that’s not something to just accept.
If anything, I’m resisting, fighting to survive.
“However, it’s important to understand things deeply.”
“Understand deeply…”
That’s the Brave Family’s way of perceiving things.
“Both enemies and allies live on the same ground, so do not underestimate or overestimate either side; know them deeply and prepare—if you want to survive.”
It’s similar to the saying that if you know your enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles.
“Alicia, this land is fundamentally hard to accept, but by understanding it deeply, it can become more bearable.”
Why we fight, for whom we fight, why we won, and why we lost.
Knowing those things is crucial.
In this situation where my family has been killed in battle, I’m not grieving because I know that they all fought and fell to uphold their pride.
“Everyone fights knowing this land. They decide everything for themselves.”
“Right…”
Perhaps she had her own thoughts on the matter, as Alicia nodded seriously.
“I’ve been observing the expressions of the people living here, and I thought it wasn’t the kind of place I had heard about.”
“The people of Brave Territory don’t laugh at decisions made after much deliberation.”
Strangely enough, even the roughnecks value that aspect.
“Things have gotten a bit gloomy again, huh? You can laugh it off, you know? This is a place where life and death are treated as a joke.”
“You say laugh, but then you say don’t laugh; it’s confusing.”
“Maybe it just means we’re living in the moment? Hahaha.”
Because no one knows when they might die, everyone spends money freely.
Alicia was complaining, but her expression had softened a little.
It was a natural expression, one that didn’t seem to fit the image of a villainous noblewoman.
“Oh, we’re almost there, Alicia.”
As we chatted while climbing the mountain, I pulled Alicia’s hand, who was desperately trying to keep up.
“Hah… You’ve been saying we’re almost there since we entered the mountains, but I’m starting to doubt your words… Hah.”
Soft, white, and light.
The Brave Family prefers women to be a bit healthier, so I should feed her and help her gain some weight.
“Next time, I promise we’re almost there. I doubt the duchess’s family does much mountain climbing or rock climbing, so it probably just feels longer because you’re not used to it.”
“I don’t want to get used to it…”
“But that’s what we humans do, you know…”
I had boasted about being in a fantasy world, but the reality was a bloody world where human lives are incredibly cheap.
It’s sad that I’ve become accustomed to killing without even realizing it, having been a city boy in modern society.
“I’m sorry to interrupt your dazed expression, but could you hurry up and pull me up…?”
“Oh, my apologies.”
I had forgotten about Alicia, who was hanging in mid-air, just holding her hand while climbing the cliff.
It was a ridiculous tale of an otherworldly reincarnation, and just like Alicia now, I had been pale with fear.
“Wah…”
As I pulled her up from the cliff, Alicia let out a small voice of surprise.
Before us stood a towering mountain range, but when I turned back, I could see the forest we had walked through and the Brave Territory spreading out beyond it.
“This is my favorite spot. It might seem inferior compared to the Royal Capital, but I really like it.”
The buildings, fields, and rivers looked tiny, like a miniature garden, and if someone said there was nothing else, that would be true, but that was what made it nice.
Perhaps because I had lived in a stressful society in my previous life, such scenery cleansed my heart.
Someday, I want to make a paraglider and jump off from here.
“Well then, Alicia, you must be hungry after all that walking, so how about we have a light meal here?”
Alicia, who had been silently gazing at the scenery with her hands clasped tightly to her chest, spoke.
“Tiny, huh?”

“Right? The buildings visible from here are so small that they seem like they would crumble if I flicked them with my finger. Oh, by the way, that collapsed house over there was really destroyed by a giant monster called Giganotos, which flicked it away with its finger.”
“…That’s not what I meant.”
Oh, it was a Brave Family-style monster joke, but I guess I still don’t understand a maiden’s heart.
“Laguna, I want to ask you something.”
“Feel free to call me by my name. I’m not used to being addressed with honorifics.”
Due to Sebas, the term “young master” had become ingrained, and since I was inheriting the family headship, the servants didn’t use honorifics.
All my family members who used to call me by my name are already dead.
“Then it’s fine for me to call you by your name too, and no need for honorifics.”
“No, that’s a bit…”
“Well, in this place, that seems trivial and insignificant, doesn’t it?”
Seeing me smile wryly, Alicia had a triumphant look on her face.
It was a good sign that the magic bug that had been clinging to her was peeling off with every smile.
“That’s true.”
So I decided to stop using honorifics honestly.
I’ll just use them in public settings.
“Hey, Laguna.”
As Alicia looked down at the Brave Territory, she spoke.
“After much deliberation, if you make a decision and try to accept the results, but still… if you find yourself regretting it, what would you do?”
Her smile had vanished, and the magic bug seemed to be crawling back to life.
It would be rude to ask what kind of decision she was referring to right now.
She was probably talking about what had happened at the academy, and depending on my answer, a path to ruin might await her.
“Is the answer that time will heal… just a pretty sentiment?”
Seeing that Alicia was silently listening, I continued.
“It’s natural that once you make a decision, you can’t choose the other option, and even if you clear your grudges, you can’t bring back what’s lost.”
Just like in my previous life, and just like my family who had died, some things are beyond saving.
After hearing that my family had died in battle, I chased after the enemy commander for revenge, despite being stopped by those around me.
Even in a situation of overwhelming disadvantage, I didn’t stop, even if it meant sacrificing my soldiers.
That’s why I have only a handful of servants left.
Death in battle is considered honorable, and seeking revenge in a disadvantageous situation is something foolish, but it was unbearable that the family I had spent time with was gone—

“No matter how obvious it seems, regret will still linger. But at that moment, I realized something. It meant that they loved me enough for me to feel that way, and that there are still those who remain.”
Looking at the Brave Territory spread out before me, I continued speaking while observing the servants running through the streets like tiny dots and the villagers heading to work in the fields.

“It’s not like everything has vanished; there are still many things left. That’s why I’m determined to try my best as a noble, even though I don’t want to be one, and I plan to attend the academy, even though I don’t want to.”
According to the scenario, this country would be afflicted by various disasters and wars.
Even though it would become a battlefield or a stage for monster disasters, Brave Territory was treated as a minor character, even less than that, in the game.
I want to resist this fate.
I won’t let my beloved family and my second hometown become stepping stones for a terrible plot, and that’s the important determination I hold in my heart.
Well, I won’t say it out loud!
Keeping that precious feeling in my heart gives me strength from within, as per the Brave Family’s saying.
“…What if there’s nothing left?”
Alicia, who had been listening to me, asked.
“What if you’ve been taught since birth that you have a duty to fulfill, and you’ve lived your life for that purpose, but it turns out it’s something you can never achieve again?”
“If you’re not dead, there’s still something left.”
I replied shortly, as Alicia seemed to be getting a bit emotional.
It seemed that her former fiancé, the prince, still lingered in her heart.
Having been engaged to the prince, she had poured her entire life into that relationship, and there was no way a fifteen-year-old girl could easily shake that off.
This is just a guess, but perhaps that strong sense of duty and love had been exploited by the magic bug, leading to the creation of a truly villainous noblewoman.
Love and hatred are intricately intertwined.
Hmm, I feel a bit like I’ve experienced heartbreak?
“There’s nothing left! The past me is dead… As the duchess… that’s why I’m in this discarded land… Ah, I’m sorry, that was a slip of the tongue.”
She touched the burn scar on her left eye, murmuring as the magic bug crawled around her like a curse, but she realized her slip and looked down.
What should I do? The current Alicia is a new Alicia, so I felt hesitant to suggest she start anew in this land.
I, too, have lost my family and have never been able to reconcile such issues.
Facts are facts, and I can only bear them like a man, but I didn’t know how to respond.
There are multiple characters to pursue, so I could try to steer the protagonist away from the prince’s route and find a way to bring Alicia back to her original self.
It would be a similar path to the villainous noblewoman route, but unlike the game, I’m here, so she wouldn’t go berserk due to the magic bug, and I believe Alicia could prove her worth.
Ah, but that might not work.
In the end, the protagonist would be recognized as a saint in the latter half, and the prince’s discerning eye would come into play, leaving Alicia with no place to stand.
I’m stuck…? Damn it!
As I was mulling over this troubling situation, I felt a bit irritated, perhaps because of the Brave Family’s bloodline.
Alright, let’s think simply.
Sebas had said it too; it’s better to face things head-on in a way that suits me.
So I’ll express my honest feelings—
“Alicia, I’ll protect you for the rest of my life.”
“…Huh?”
Alicia’s eyes widened in surprise at my sudden declaration.
I don’t know if keeping her by my side is the right route or if it’s about holding onto her tightly, but I simply wanted to do that.
If I’m beside her, I might be able to sense the path to ruin, and seeing her being tossed around by this terrible fate somehow reminded me of myself, making me want to protect her fiercely.
“If the duchess you were is dead, then the Alicia standing before me now is the one who has married into the Brave Family.”
I extended my pinky to Alicia, who was still in shock.
In this other world, a pinky swear symbolizes a promise.
“Then I can promise you this: I will definitely protect you.”
What kind of Brave Family would I be if I couldn’t protect my territory and family? With that pride in my heart, I live for the present.
There’s no way love exists between two people who have just met, and my words might sound like the empty phrases of a frivolous man, but this feeling is entirely genuine and without deceit.
“I’ve been thinking since this morning, but you really do have a lot of unpredictable remarks.”
“Well, I tried to find some clever words, but the boys of the Brave Family aren’t used to this kind of situation, so only my honest words came out.”
I truly believe this family isn’t suited for nobility.
How much easier it would have been if we were just a family of soldiers.
“…Heh.”
Seeing me scratching my head, Alicia chuckled softly.
“Was it really that strange? I’ve never said anything like that before; my father and brothers were the type to speak through their actions…”
Alicia tried to cover it up.
“Actually, it’s the first time someone has said that to my face.”
“Really? I thought as a duchess, you’d have heard such things from various people.”
“People who throw out such random words are usually avoided, you know?”
Huh? Isn’t that the kind of flowery language typical of nobility?
“Damn… All the practice I secretly did to come up with nice lines for when I attend the academy has gone to waste…”
“What kind of ridiculous practice is that?”
“Hey, I’m the third son, and I’ve never interacted with other nobles, so it can’t be helped. The Brave Family is completely lacking in that area.”
It was a bit shocking.
If there hadn’t been a talk of Alicia marrying into the family, I would have been branded as a pickup artist right after starting at the academy.
Seeing me with my head in my hands, Alicia sighed as if exasperated.
“But I don’t dislike it. It’s straightforward.”
That shy smile at that moment was so captivating that I found myself entranced for the first time in my life.
“Indeed, as you said, I might have been overthinking things.”
While looking down at Brave Territory, she murmured.
“It’s tiny, tiny. Clinging to a past that’s gone and sulking forever…”
“Well, that’s just how humans are.”
“But in the Brave Family, isn’t that considered taboo?”
“Yeah, it’s acceptable once. The key is to switch gears from then on.”
When I said that honestly, she extended her pinky to me.

“From now on, if you return to the academy with me, you’ll probably attract a lot of attention. Honestly, you might not have a place to fit in, and I think there will be a lot of hostility and malice, but… will you still protect me?”
“I’m good at that, so leave it to me.”
Her white, beautiful finger linked with my calloused, dirty one.
This feels nice.
I don’t care about ruin anymore; I just want the Royal Capital to continue its own romantic love story in this otome game.
I’m going to share my fate with Alicia, yes.
Then an idea struck me.
To solidify this promise, I should have a third party witness it.
To prove my words aren’t just empty, and as the most romantic expression of affection I can offer, I’ll call him.
“Alicia, wait a moment; I want to redo the part where I swear.”
“…Huh?”
Uh-oh, her expression was starting to look a bit dissatisfied.
This is bad; I wanted to make sure to swear properly here.
“Just a moment, I’ll call him right now—Onyx!”
As I called the name, a massive black dragon descended from the sky beside me.
That was quick?
He must have been secretly watching me.
The fact that no monsters appeared along the way was proof of that.
“What do you need, Laguna Vel Brave?”
“What do I need? You should know if you were watching, right?”
The glossy black giant with white stripes was named Onyx.
He’s a friend.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXTLOew.jpeg
“I swear to protect her for the rest of my life, so please bear witness.”
“You swear in front of a dragon… Do you understand what it means to break that promise?”
“Of course.”
If I were to break it, I’d have to offer my body to the dragon, meaning I’d be eaten.
“I have no intention of breaking it, and it’s more convenient for you that way, right?”
“Do as you wish.”
“Alright! Alicia, I swear to protect you for the rest of my life, I swear it to the dragon.”
Having received his approval, I turned back to Alicia, who had rolled her eyes and fainted.
“Uh, what…?”
“To faint like that, what a weak girl. Well, let’s just say I’ve witnessed the vow. Farewell.”
With that, Onyx took off, flapping his wings and soaring over the mountain range.
Swearing to a dragon felt like something out of a fairy tale, romantic even, but I never expected it to end like this.
The next day, it was no surprise that Alicia stormed into my study while I was working on paperwork.
She had slept until morning, likely exhausted from the climb, so it was only natural.
“Laguna! Hey, Laguna!”
Her demeanor was quite active, a stark contrast to before, and even Sebas stroked his proud mustache with a “Oh my.”
“Yes, this is Laguna.”
“What was that yesterday!? What was it!?”
As I replied, she slammed her hands on the desk, leaning in close.
The magic bugs were still thick on the windows of the house, but they had completely been removed from her body, leaving her looking refreshed.
Of course, after that vow, it was as if she had gained the dragon’s protection, so no matter how many magic bugs tried to swarm her, they couldn’t even get close.
It was more like a lingering scent of protection, a complete success of the magic bug eradication operation with Onyx.
“Yesterday… I thought swearing in front of a dragon was quite romantic…”
Heroic tales exist in this world too, and dragons are known to everyone, whether they are the calamity-bringing evil dragons or the ones who fought alongside heroes to defeat the demon king.
They are powerful and terrifying, yet somehow mystical and beautiful creatures.
Dragons possess the intelligence to speak with humans and have lived since ancient times, making them surprisingly knowledgeable and interesting to talk to.
“So does that mean the Brave Family has a dragon under its command!?”
Whether it’s romantic or not seemed irrelevant to her; she just wanted to know why the dragon was there at that moment.
“We don’t command him.”
“Indeed.”
Sebas, who had been present when I met Onyx, nodded in agreement with my words.
Since I didn’t want to be interrupted by her continuous questions, I decided to explain succinctly.
“Onyx is a dragon that recently came to Brave Territory. He lives deep in the mountain range, and because of him, we had a major problem with a monster stampede, right, Sebas?”
“Indeed.”
When I heard that people from the neighboring country had said there was plenty of food here, I felt a bit resentful toward our neighbors.
“Alicia, what do you think would happen if a dragon appeared in a land without dragons?”
“Um… Something terrible would happen? I can’t even imagine…”
“Exactly, something terrible would happen. Perfect score, you’re amazing.”
“Just tell me properly, will you?”
Since I was about to lose my temper, I explained.
“First, the monsters living in the mountains would be startled and flee all at once, but that wave of monsters would hit Brave Territory directly.”
While I was rushing to deploy soldiers and adventurers to suppress the monster riot, the neighboring country had attacked as if they knew what was happening, and my family had been slaughtered.
“It’s unforgivable for them to use a dragon to attack us, right, Sebas?”
“Indeed.”
With great power comes great responsibility, and when I told Onyx that he was being used for their benefit, he was outraged and burned down the border fort with his breath.
Haha, I managed to pull it off well.
“…Even though you don’t command him, why do you seem so calm about it?”
“That’s because the young master has been recognized by Lord Onyx.”
“That’s right.”
At that time, I had entered the mountains to find the cause of the monster riot and discovered Onyx.
Of course, when I asked him to leave immediately because monsters were flooding into the territory, he simply replied, “I don’t care about that.”
From the perspective of dragons, we humans are inferior beings, right?
“Even so, I had to do something, so we ended up in a battle.”
“The young master challenged him alone and reached a draw, right? Ah, the moment he was recognized by Lord Onyx was truly moving.”
“I almost died, you know?”
Sebas was creating a dramatic atmosphere, but…
“Thanks to that, I was able to negotiate with Onyx, so it turned out well.”
He had burned down the neighboring country, and I secured a promise that Onyx would regularly thin out the massive number of monsters, which gave me time to attend the academy.
“Once a dragon makes a promise, they’ll keep it with pride, so I think they’re more reliable than those adventurers.”
However, that doesn’t mean they’re inherently good.
If we were to take advantage of the situation and develop the mountains while Onyx is around, he might get angry, thinking he’s being used, and it’s best not to even think about trying to hunt him.
He had come to Brave Territory after devouring the mountains of the neighboring country, and once he’s done with us, he’ll probably fly away somewhere.
Who knows how many years that will take?
At worst, since he had shown interest in human food, there’s also the strategy of regularly bringing him food and saying, “Please let us off the hook for this.”
Sebas, I’m counting on you for the feeding.
“…That was too grand for me to understand.”
That was Alicia’s response after hearing my story.
“I thought I could finally be optimistic, but I was surprised thinking I might get eaten by a dragon…”
“Haha, even so, I’ll protect you. I swore to a dragon, so I’ll definitely protect you, whether it’s Onyx or another dragon.”
“…I feel like I’m being foolish for panicking; here I am… ha…”
As I laughed, Alicia let out a sigh, looking utterly exhausted.
From a general perspective, the Brave Family is the special one, so it’s fine for me to be the fool, but since she’s trying her best to adapt to this land, I won’t say anything.
“Alicia, when I first came here, I was just as surprised. Eventually, you’ll get used to it, so keep fighting.”
“Is that so…”
It was a casual remark from Sebas, but I wondered how long he had been a butler for the Brave Family.
His face hasn’t changed at all since childhood.
“Let me help.”
“Eh, what do you mean?”
Just as I was about to ask Alicia, who was still lingering at the desk to leave the room since she was interrupting my work, she extended her hand.
“You mentioned yesterday that you were short-handed, right? I’ll help.”
“Oh!”
“I’ll teach you a bit about the academy during my free time. If I take you there in your current state, you might get expelled.”
“Eh…”
I had indeed held some strange fantasies, but was it that serious?
I thought I’d be looked at with colored glasses since I was a noble from the Discarded Land, but would it really be enough to get expelled?
“I’ve been getting some lessons from Sebas, you know?”
It’s my job to secure support from higher-ranking nobles.
I can grind sesame seeds as much as I want!
“I’ve taught you the etiquette for public occasions, but I’m somewhat old-fashioned, so I’m not familiar with the culture and etiquette of the young people living in the Royal Capital.”
“Right?”
That meant that my previous actions had confirmed that “this guy has a high chance of getting expelled,” and it was a bit shocking.
“Am I the type of guy who would be embarrassed to walk beside someone?”
“That’s not it.”
Alicia said to me, who was in shock.
“I don’t care about others’ evaluations or such trivial matters. It’s just… if you’re with me, even if you do something clumsy, you might get blamed and pushed toward expulsion…”
“Hm, then I can’t keep my promise, can I?”
Seeing Alicia’s slightly pained expression, Sebas chimed in to offer support.
“Young master, this is a good opportunity. Let’s have her teach you about the academy.”
“Understood.”

Even though she said she didn’t care about others’ evaluations, I didn’t want Alicia to feel embarrassed because of my shortcomings, so I just resolved to become a man worthy of walking beside a beautiful woman.
It’s a necessary effort to protect her; it’s my duty.
